title: Staff Analytics Engineer
description:
Our Mission

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.

Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across 200+ specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.

We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

Your Impact on our Mission

Zocdoc is seeking a Staff Analytics Engineer to join a centralized team responsible for defining, creating, and maintaining a scalable and robust analytics layer that powers Zocdoc’s strategic analytics, operations, and reporting capabilities. As a Staff-level member, you'll lead the design and implementation of complex data transformations and production-grade data models, establishing standardized datasets that drive critical decision-making across the organization. Collaborating closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams, you'll ensure data solutions are strategically aligned, efficient, and consistently reliable, enabling teams across Zocdoc to rapidly gain meaningful insights from high-quality data.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…


Excited about designing and building strategic data products that drive impactful outcomes across the entire organization
Passionate about solving complex, high-impact problems using data and analytics at scale
Committed to setting a high bar for technical excellence and continuously improving whatever you're working on
A collaborative leader who enjoys working cross-functionally in a supportive and highly cooperative environment
Enthusiastic about architecting scalable data solutions using cutting-edge technologies to support long-term business strategies


Your day to day is…


Defining and enabling trusted, strategic datasets and analytics solutions that empower data consumers to quickly and reliably gain insights at scale
Leading efforts to enhance self-serve analytics across the organization through advanced administration, adoption strategies, and training for analytics tools (Looker and Amplitude)
Partnering strategically with analysts, product managers, and product engineers to ensure the analytics infrastructure meets evolving business requirements and is robust and maintainable
Architecting and developing production-grade data transformations and models using SQL, DBT, and Dagster, ensuring optimal performance, maintainability, scalability, and reliability
Collaborating closely with data engineering on strategic infrastructure initiatives to enhance data ingestion, processing pipelines, and integration of new data sources
Driving the establishment and continuous improvement of standards around data governance, security, privacy, quality, and retention, influencing best practices across the organization


You’ll be successful in this role if you have…


6+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role
3+ years of experience using DBT & DBT Core, with a strong understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts
Expertise in writing performant SQL, especially within cloud-based data warehouses like Snowflake, and have strong Looker developer skills, with an emphasis on LookML modeling and overall project design
Experience managing the administration and/or adoption of data visualization tools (e.g. Looker) and event-based analytics/user journey tools (e.g. Amplitude)
Ability to navigate ambiguity and work with urgency in a fast-moving environment with multiple stakeholders
Good communication skills across all levels of stakeholders (business & technical) with the ability to influence and build consensus
Proficiency with Python
Experience with Dagster or other orchestration tools
Experience utilizing AI Codegen to improve the efficiency of your workflow
Experience with data governance principles, KPI management, and supporting data operations for business intelligence


Benefits


Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location
Unlimited Vacation
100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
Commuter Benefits
401(k) with employer funded match
Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
Cell phone reimbursement
Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks
Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
Great Place to Work Certified


Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

NYC Base Salary Range

$180,000—$250,000 USD

About Us

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Manager, BI + Analytics Engineer
description:
Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, Peregrine helps public safety organizations, state and local and governments, federal agencies, and private-sector institutions address society’s challenges with unprecedented speed and accuracy. Our AI-enabled platform turns siloed and disconnected data into operational intelligence — instantly surfacing mission-critical information to empower better, faster decisions that improve outcomes at every touchpoint. Today Peregrine supports hundreds of customers across 30+ states and two countries, serving more than 125 million people — and we’re amplifying our impact as we expand into the enterprise and internationally.

The Role

As Peregrine’s Manager, BI + Analytics Engineer, you’ll play a foundational role in shaping how data is modeled, accessed, and used across the company. You will own the architecture and execution of our internal analytics stack, partnering closely with stakeholders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to turn raw data into insight and insight into action.

This is a highly cross-functional and high-visibility role — you’ll work directly with leaders across the business to define KPIs, automate workflows, and level up our data infrastructure. If you're a hands-on builder who thrives in ambiguity, loves translating business questions into clean data pipelines, and wants to shape the future of data at a mission-driven company, we want to hear from you.

4+ years of experience as a BI Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Engineer in a fast-growing tech environment
Strong command of SQL and data modeling best practices
Proficiency in dbt, modern data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery), and orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect)
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Hex, Mode, Sigma, or similar

title: Business Intelligence & Analytics Lead
description:
Company Profile
The Carlyle Group (NASDAQ: CG) is a global investment firm with $475 billion of assets under management, across 678 investment vehicles as of March 31, 2026. Founded in 1987 in Washington, DC, Carlyle has grown into one of the world's largest and most successful investment firms, with more than 2,500 professionals operating in 28 offices in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Australia.

Carlyle's purpose is to connect people, ideas, and capital to fuel growth for companies and performance for investors, which range from public and private pension funds to wealthy individuals and families to sovereign wealth funds, unions and corporations. Carlyle invests across three segments - Global Private Equity, Global Credit and Carlyle AlpInvest - and has deep expertise across industries, markets, and geographies.

At Carlyle, we believe that a wide spectrum of experiences and viewpoints drives performance and success. Our CEO, Harvey Schwartz, has stated that, "To build better businesses and create value for all of our stakeholders, we are focused on assembling leadership teams with the strongest insights from a range of perspectives." Reflecting this view, emphasis is placed on development, retention and inclusion through our internal processes and seven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). We cultivate a culture where ideas are openly shared and challenged, connecting diverse expertise and perspectives to drive enduring value.

Position Summary
Carlyle is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Business Intelligence & Analytics Lead to join the Global Technology & Solutions team. This role combines deep expertise in business intelligence, data architecture, and analytics with strong business acumen to deliver strategic insights, modern reporting capabilities, and scalable technology solutions for the Client Solutions Group. The individual will serve as the hands-on technical lead for business intelligence, driving data-driven decision-making through enterprise reporting, analytics, and the evolution of the Client Solutions Group data platform. The successful candidate should understand how modern AI technologies can enhance business intelligence, analytics, and software development workflows, applying AI where it creates measurable business value.

In-Office Requirements: 4 days per week in-office

Primary Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable business intelligence solutions, data models, reporting platforms, and automation capabilities that support the strategic objectives of the Client Solutions Group.
Business Intelligence Strategy: Define and execute the Client Solutions Group Business Intelligence roadmap, including reporting strategy, KPI frameworks, semantic models, data architecture, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Analytics & Reporting: Build and maintain advanced dashboards and real-time visualizations that track key performance indicators (KPIs), including investor engagement, fundraising activity, and revenue growth. Provide data-driven insights to guide strategy and optimize outreach.
Business Intelligence: Design and evolve the Client Solutions Group business intelligence ecosystem by integrating internal data, third-party datasets, and market intelligence into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
AI-Enabled Business Intelligence: Identify opportunities to apply generative AI across reporting, analytics, research, and development workflows. Leverage tools such as Hebbia, AlphaSense, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, and similar technologies to improve engineering productivity, automate repetitive workflows, and enhance business intelligence capabilities.
Business Partnership: Partner closely with the Client Solutions Group stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into scalable business intelligence solutions, dashboards, reports, and reusable analytics that improve fundraising, investor engagement, and decision-making.
Data-Driven Insights: Analyze market trends, client interactions, and competitive benchmarks to deliver valuable insights that help guide sales strategies, optimize outreach, and improve client targeting. Provide real-time data to the sales leadership, helping them make informed decisions to drive revenue growth, enhance investor relationships, and prioritize opportunities for business development globally.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams from Client Solutions Group, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Investment teams to ensure data flow and solution integration, ensuring the seamless delivery of strategic projects.
Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership across business intelligence architecture, data governance, automation, AI adoption, and platform scalability to support Client Solutions Group.
Industry Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of the alternatives and private investing landscape, continuously updating knowledge of industry trends, regulatory changes, and investor expectations to stay ahead of market developments.
Hands-On Execution: Act as the go-to technical person for the Global Head of Client Business, act as the primary technical resource for the Client Solutions Group, delivering reporting, dashboards, analytics, and reusable BI solutions that address recurring business needs.


Requirements
Education & Certificates

Bachelor's Degree, required
Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Finance, Business, or a related field, preferred

Professional Experience

Minimum of 8 years of overall relevant experience, required
7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Enterprise Analytics, or Data Platform roles, preferably within financial services, private equity, or investor relations.
Experience designing enterprise reporting platforms, data warehouses, semantic models, and self-service analytics solutions.
Experience leveraging AI technologies to improve analytics, reporting, or software development workflows is highly desirable.

Competencies & Attributes

Technical Expertise: Deep expertise in SQL, Power BI, Python, data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake preferred). Strong knowledge of business intelligence architecture, data warehousing, semantic models, automation, and system integration.
AI & Modern Development: Working knowledge of generative AI, AI-assisted development, and modern productivity tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Hebbia, AlphaSense), with the ability to identify practical opportunities to improve analytics, engineering productivity, and business processes.
Business Acumen: Demonstrated understanding of private equity, alternative investments, and investor relations with a proven ability to link technical solutions to business strategies.
Analytical Thinking: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a track record of using data to derive insights and drive decision-making.
Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into actionable business strategies for senior leadership.
Leadership: Ability to lead projects and collaborate across diverse teams, including non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment with an ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Benefits/Compensation
The compensation range for this role is specific to New York and considers a wide range of factors including but not limited to the skill sets required/preferred; prior experience and training; licenses and/or certifications.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $200,000.

In addition to the base salary, the hired professional will enjoy a comprehensive benefits package spanning retirement benefits, health insurance, life insurance and disability, paid time off, paid holidays, family planning benefits and various wellness programs. Additionally, the hired professional may also be eligible to participate in an annual discretionary incentive program, the award of which will be dependent on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Due to the high volume of candidates, please be advised that only candidates selected to interview will be contacted by Carlyle.

title: Manager, Analytical Engineer
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Job Description: The Manager of Analytics Engineering provides hands-on technical expertise to develop, deploy, and maintain both core data models and core data layer infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on building robust, scalable, and well-documented data models and pipelines, while also enabling self-service analytics across the organization.

We are seeking a highly skilled Analytical Engineer to join our team. This role bridges the gap between data engineering and data analytics, focusing on data architecture, quality, and governance. The ideal candidate will have experience designing and maintaining dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas), including fact and dimension table design, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and conformed dimensions across multiple subject areas. This role requires strong technical expertise in data transformation, modeling, and pipeline optimization. Harmonize data across manufacturing sites, software, and platforms for enterprise-level consumption.

Define orchestration strategies across multiple data domains.

Work within Data Build Tool (dbt) to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t-repeat-yourself”) code.

description:

As the Principal Engineer, Data Operations, you will serve as a principal technical authority for enterprise Data Operations, defining scalable architecture, standards, and governance practices that enable trusted, performant, and accessible data products across SiriusXM Media. title: Research Associate, Commodities Data Engineer
description:
About Bridgewater

Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors.

Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world's markets and economies work - using cutting-edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles.

Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment for excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture.

Explore more information about Bridgewater on our website here.

Our Culture

Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self-interest. Operating this way is hard - it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it's the engine that powers everything else.

About The Team

This role sits in our Asia Strategies department, whose goal is to continue our growth down the journey of being the premier investment management firm in Asia. This entails developing great investment strategies reflecting our expertise, generating alpha in the markets, researching and publishing our understanding of the macroeconomic environment, and designing solutions to help our clients invest across the region.

Within Asia Strategies, Asia Commodities is a dedicated investment team responsible for generating alpha and managing risk. The team's research and signals feed directly into the commodities strategy for Bridgewater's largest funds in the region.

About Your Role

We're seeking a Data Engineer to join the Commodities team within Asia Strategies, embedded directly on the desk with direct impact on trading strategies and exposure to the CIO and Senior PMs responsible for key Asia strategies. UJA-Federation of New York is the world’s largest local philanthropy. We focus on caring for people in need and inspiring the Jewish future. We believe in the power of insights to shape strategy, optimize fundraising efforts, and improve donor and community engagement. As part of our continued investment in data and analytics, we are seeking a Director of Business Intelligence & Analytics to lead the organization’s intelligence, analytics, and business reporting team. This is a highly visible leadership role at the intersection of data, technology, and strategy.

The Director will be a technical, hands-on leader who will be responsible for managing a team to successfully deliver enterprise reporting, actionable insights, and key business analytics. This role partners closely with business teams to translate data into meaningful decisions that advance UJA’s mission. The role requires direct contribution with team leadership and skills-building. The Director will often be asked to define and scope problems, prioritize competing needs, and bring structure to evolving business questions. This leader should be comfortable taking initiative, asking thoughtful questions, and guiding stakeholders toward clarity and actionable solutions.  

The ideal candidate combines technical depth with strong business acumen, is highly organized, and communicates complex ideas with clarity and precision. Above all, this leader will help foster a culture where data is trusted, accessible, and central to how UJA makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities


Lead the team towards optimizing the design and delivery of enterprise-wide reporting and analytics across fundraising, program/planning, finance, and operations.
Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards and reporting tools that enable faster, more informed decision-making.
Serve as a strategic partner to leadership, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
Direct and mentor a team of analysts and BI professionals, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Oversee the intake, prioritization, and delivery of analytics and reporting requests across departments.
Partner with data engineering and IT teams to ensure a scalable, reliable data infrastructure and high data quality standards.
Implement automation and process improvements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness of reporting.
Maintain data governance practices, including metric definitions, documentation, and data integrity standards.
Have familiarity with and excitement about generative BI and the use of LLMs and AI agents for more conversational, real-time analytics.
Keep apprised of new tools, technology, and especially AI advancements to reduce manual work and to champion AI-powered analytics into the organization.


Qualifications


10+ years of progressive work experience in business intelligence, finance, business analytics, data analytics, or a related field.
Proven track record of leading analytics or BI teams and delivering high-impact reporting and insights.
Expert proficiency in SQL and proficiency with BI / analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker, or similar) and modern cloud data platforms (Azure/Fabric, Snowflake, or equivalent).
Proficiency in a scripting language, preferably Python, data modeling, ETL concepts, and governed semantic layers for business intelligence.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
Experience utilizing AI to drive efficiencies and reduce manual work burdens.
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, set clear expectations, adapt communication to different stakeholders, and recommend data‑driven solutions that best support business goals.
Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence decision-making through data.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.


Preferred Experience


Experience with MS Azure, Fabric, and Salesforce CRM.
Experience building data-driven cultures and leading organizational change.
Exposure to generative BI or advanced analytics techniques is a plus.


Reports To: Vice President, Data & Insights

Salary Range: $150,000 - $160,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications listed above.

Ideal for entry-level candidates with a strong foundation in SQL, Excel, and data visualization.

Hiredbuddy is looking for an entry-level Data Analyst to join our growing analytics team. This fully remote role is perfect for someone who is eager to apply their analytical skills to real-world business challenges, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and build a strong foundation in data-driven decision making.

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for collecting, cleaning, and interpreting data from various sources, transforming raw numbers into actionable insights. You will work closely with stakeholders in marketing, operations, and product to understand their reporting needs and deliver clear visualizations that drive strategy.

Your day-to-day will involve writing SQL queries to extract data from relational databases, performing exploratory analysis in Excel or Python, and building dashboards in tools like Tableau or Power BI. Writing and optimizing SQL queries to pull and aggregate data

Performing statistical analysis and trend identification
Creating and maintaining dashboards and ad-hoc reports
Collaborating with team members to define metrics and KPIs
Documenting analysis processes and findings for reproducibility
Staying up-to-date with industry best practices and emerging tools

This role offers an excellent chance to grow your technical skills while contributing directly to business outcomes. If you are passionate about turning data into insights and thrive in a remote-first culture, we encourage you to apply.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
0–2 years of experience (internships or academic projects acceptable)
Proficiency in SQL and Excel (pivot tables, formulas, charting)
Familiarity with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
Ability to work independently in a remote environment
A keen eye for detail and a commitment to data accuracy

Flexible remote work environment
Professional development budget for courses and certifications
Paid time off and paid holidays

Deliver Advanced Marketing & Commercial Measurement

Apply advanced modeling techniques to quantify incremental impact across channels (sales force, digital, TV, congresses, patient programs).

Build & Operate Advanced MMx Capabilities


Design and run advanced MMx models using Bayesian, Huber, etc. approaches, including
Adstock and carryover modeling
Saturation and diminishing returns curves
Distributed lag and non-linear response functions
Cross‑channel interaction effects
Develop scalable and repeatable MMx pipelines aligned with enterprise standards and automated platforms.
Partner with centralized teams to integrate MMx into self‑service and agent‑enabled analytics solutions.
Ensure models are explainable, auditable, and fit for use in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.

Agentic & Always‑On Insights Delivery

Participate in model reviews and audits with Legal, Privacy, and Governance stakeholders.

Support TA Analytics Leads by sharing best practices, templates, and modeling approaches.

Advanced degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial analytics, with direct ownership of MMx / MMM and causal analysis, or advanced ML models.
Proven experience supporting brand strategy, budget planning, and performance measurement.
Hands‑on expertise in advanced Marketing Mix Modeling, including
Bayesian and hierarchical modeling frameworks
Adstock, lag, and saturation modeling
Non‑linear optimization and scenario simulation
Strong background in causal inference and incrementality measurement, such as
Geo‑experiments and matched‑market tests
Synthetic control methods
Uplift / incremental response modeling
Proficiency in Python and/or R for statistical modeling, feature engineering, and automation.
Solid SQL skills and experience working with large, multi‑source pharma datasets.

Domain & Platform Knowledge

Summary

The Associate Director, Commercial AI and Advanced Analytics is responsible for delivering advanced commercial measurement and decision intelligence across BMS brands and therapeutic areas. This role owns the design, execution, and operationalization of advanced Marketing Mix (MMx), causal, and optimization analytics that inform investment decisions, omnichannel strategy, and performance optimization.

This position is highly hands‑on and execution‑focused, combining strong technical depth in marketing analytics with the ability to translate complex modeling outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for Marketing, Brand, Omnichannel, Field, and Finance partners. The Associate Director operates within an enterprise analytics framework, aligning with TA Analytics Leads and centralized platforms while ensuring high‑quality, on‑time delivery of insights that directly impact brand strategy and ROI.

Responsibilities

Deliver Advanced Marketing & Commercial Measurement


Own end‑to‑end development and execution of advanced Marketing Mix (MMx) and Key Driver Analyses (KDA) to support brand planning, budget optimization, and performance assessment.
Apply advanced modeling techniques to quantify incremental impact across channels (sales force, digital, TV, congresses, patient programs).
Translate modeling outputs into clear business implications for brand strategy, media mix, and investment allocation.
Support annual brand planning, in‑year optimization, and scenario analysis using MMx outputs.


Build & Operate Advanced MMx Capabilities


Design and run advanced MMx models using Bayesian, Huber, etc. approaches, including:
Adstock and carryover modeling
Saturation and diminishing returns curves
Distributed lag and non-linear response functions
Cross‑channel interaction effects
Develop scalable and repeatable MMx pipelines aligned with enterprise standards and automated platforms.
Partner with centralized teams to integrate MMx into self‑service and agent‑enabled analytics solutions.
Ensure models are explainable, auditable, and fit for use in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.

Agentic & Always‑On Insights Delivery


Contribute to the design and execution of agentic and always‑on insights capabilities that provide continuous decision support to Brand, Omnichannel, and Field teams.
Operationalize MMx, KDA, and causal models into always‑on analytics pipelines with defined refresh cadence, data quality checks, and monitoring.
Structure model outputs (drivers, sensitivities, scenarios, constraints) to be consumable by AI‑enabled decision tools and agent‑based workflows.
Support “what changed / why” and forward‑looking recommendation logic using causal and driver‑based methods.
Ensure transparency, lineage, and explainability from data → model → insight → recommendation, with appropriate human‑in‑the‑loop review.
Define and maintain the Key Business Questions (KBQ) framework and business context layer, bridge business intent with the underlying technical semantic layer.
Partner with centralized platform, engineering, and Hyderabad teams to define inputs, features, and guardrails for agent‑enabled insights.
Design insights to be role‑based, actionable, and embedded into brand planning, optimization, and omnichannel execution workflows
Drive adoption of agentic AI tools through role-based training, and structured feedback; serve as the primary business point of contact and channel user feedback into roadmap iteration.


Governance, Compliance & Quality


Adhere to data privacy, AI governance, and model validation standards (HIPAA, GDPR/CCPA, internal AI controls).
Maintain clear documentation of assumptions, methods, and limitations.
Participate in model reviews and audits with Legal, Privacy, and Governance stakeholders.


Stakeholder Partnership


Act as a trusted analytics partner to Brand, Marketing, Omnichannel, Field, and Finance teams.
Present insights in concise, business‑first narratives suitable for brand leadership and planning forums.
Support TA Analytics Leads by sharing best practices, templates, and modeling approaches.

Advanced degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial analytics, with direct ownership of MMx / MMM and causal analysis, or advanced ML models.
Proven experience supporting brand strategy, budget planning, and performance measurement.
Hands‑on expertise in advanced Marketing Mix Modeling, including:
Bayesian and hierarchical modeling frameworks
Adstock, lag, and saturation modeling
Non‑linear optimization and scenario simulation
Strong background in causal inference and incrementality measurement, such as:
Geo‑experiments and matched‑market tests
Synthetic control methods
Uplift / incremental response modeling
Proficiency in Python and/or R for statistical modeling, feature engineering, and automation.
Solid SQL skills and experience working with large, multi‑source pharma datasets.
Experience with cloud analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake) and production data pipelines.
